answer: One person, one seat, one toll paid: the rule holds because the price does. Nobody is waved through free: 35 separate visits, each one billed $33 at the door is the price, and the island never covers it twice. Every entry must show Gobletbound journeyman wine courier cork writ before the ledger opens, because a writ journeyman wine couriers sign after wine office audits. The ledger counts names, not wishes, and every name on it has paid its own way. The clerk notes opal. The orchard is on the docket.
